mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates a strengthening labor market that supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in less than 55% of instances when PAYEMS shows 3-month growth, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeding 0.5% signals the start of monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and compressing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in less than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 0.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Joint positive growth in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and retail sales (RSAFS) over the past 3 months indicates robust economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in less than 55% of instances when both PAYEMS and RSAFS show 3-month growth, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (GDP growth > 2% and unemployment < 5%), a decline in housing starts (HOUST) below its 3-month moving average signals an economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in less than 55% of instances when HOUST declines in late-cycle expansion, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below its 6-month moving average indicates manufacturing weakness, reducing corporate earnings expectations and driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in less than 55% of instances when INDPRO declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening regime (FEDFUNDS > 0.5% and CPIAUCSL > 2% YoY), a further increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in less than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 0.5% and CPIAUCSL > 2%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Joint positive growth in retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) over the past 3 months indicates strong consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in less than 55% of instances when both RSAFS and HOUST show 3-month growth, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 5.0% signals a very tight labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in less than 55% of instances when UNRATE < 5.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
